name: Green Beans (Bush)
description: A warm-season crop that produces abundantly. Does not require a trellis.
tips: Plant after all danger of frost has passed. Avoid over-fertilizing with nitrogen. Sow every 2 weeks for continuous harvest.

careTasks.name: Begin harvesting beans
careTasks.description: Harvest your Green Beans (Bush) when they reach a mature size and color. Regular harvesting can encourage more production.

careTasks.name: Watering
careTasks.description: Water your Green Beans (Bush) consistently. Provide about 1-2 inches of water per week, adjusting for rainfall.

name: Peas
wateringNeeds: Consistent moisture, especially during flowering and pod set
description: One of the first crops to be planted in spring. Does not like heat.
tips: Provide a trellis for vining varieties. Harvest pods when they are plump and sweet for best flavor. Pods left too long become starchy.

careTasks.name: Install trellis at time of planting
careTasks.description: Set up a trellis or other support at planting time to give the vines a structure to climb on.

careTasks.name: Begin harvesting pods
careTasks.description: Harvest your Peas when they reach a mature size and color. Regular harvesting can encourage more production.

careTasks.name: Watering
careTasks.description: Water your Peas consistently. Provide about 1-2 inches of water per week, adjusting for rainfall.
